test_name: Drive Deterministic Winner & Search Lag Validation

same_oauth_client_id_or_project.note: Google Drive API drive.file scope grants read/write to files created by the application project. Both Android and iOS apps share access if registered under the same Google Cloud Console project.

different_oauth_client_id_different_proj.note: drive.file scope is strictly isolated per GCP project. Files written by project A are invisible to project B unless broader scope (e.g. drive or drive.readonly) is used.

search_lag_mitigation.problem: Drive search indexing lag (1-5s) causes concurrent writes to miss existing file in initial files.list query.
search_lag_mitigation.rule: Deterministic Winner Rule: min(files, key=(createdTime, id)). Never perform aggressive 'loser deletes' on write path. Readers deterministically bind to winner. Reconciler softly cleans duplicates after 24h grace period.
